Primary product: in-app post-call summaries + rep coaching snippets. PII concerns top-of-mind: phone numbers, email addresses, customer names appear in transcripts. Customer asks: "Can you guarantee transcripts are not stored beyond X days?" Wants default retention = 30d, ability to opt-in to longer. Also requests deletable transcripts on request and retention_controls APIs.
